summary.text: Mercedes Vazquez-Simmons is a candidate on the Mercedes Simmons Cares Party line for the New York State Assembly, District 137, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lost the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat to incumbent Demond Meeks, receiving 18.5 percent of the vote to his 81.1 percent.
